title: Starting Position
description: A shipment that hasn't left the origin dock yet should show up exactly there on the map, not at null island or the destination.
successCondition: POST /api/booking with a specific origin lat/lng. Querying the shipments table via `npm run db:psql` for the new row confirms current_lat and current_lng exactly equal origin_lat and origin_lng — the shipment starts tracking from where it was actually booked, not the destination or a zeroed default.
hints: currentLat/currentLng are set equal to originLat/originLng at creation time (see apps/api/src/modules/booking/service.ts) — nothing in Module 3 (Tracking) moves them until /api/tracking/:id/advance is called.
Pick an origin from GET /api/booking/geocode with a distinctive lat/lng (e.g. Port of Los Angeles) so the match is unambiguous.
